collection_scope: Collects complete A40r02 evidence, including failed checks. Product qualification, acceptance and conclusions are determined by the original records and main report; this collector does not claim product validation passed.

exclusion_policy.additional: *.next; id_*; .env.*; private-key/private_key names; credential suffixes; Python bytecode

verification: two complete SHA256/length reads per archived file, descriptor/path stat checks before and after each read, unchanged final selected-tree inventory; atime excluded
